531821.Flavor Text: An eerie quiet surrounds the castle—but beware of the dangerous occupant within.

531822.Description: [And I'm the Captain!] While you have 2 or more characters in play, this character gets +2 Lore.
531822.Flavor Text: "Ahoy! There's lore out there, and I'm g-gonna find it!"

531823.Description: [I Came to Listen to the Stories] Once per turn, when this character moves to a location, gain lore equal to that location's Lore.
531823.Flavor Text: The Illumineers needed someone to find a missing spellbook, and Peter was the first to volunteer.

531824.Description: [Journey] While this character is at a location, she gets +2 Strength.

531825.Description:
(A character with cost 2 or more can [Exert] to sing this song for free.)
Ready chosen character of yours at a location. They can’t quest for the rest of this turn. Gain lore equal to that location’s Lore.
531825.Flavor Text:
Tor would like to quit and be a florist
Gunther does interior design

531826.Description:
Ward (Opponents can’t choose this character except to challenge.)
Support (Whenever this character quests, you may add their Strength to another chosen character’s Strength this turn.)

531827.Description: [Listen to Your Mama Now] Whenever this character quests, you may move up to 2 damage counters from chosen character to chosen opposing character.
531827.Flavor Text: “That’s the way to give it what it needs, Juju!”

531828.Description: Resist +1 (Damage dealt to this character is reduced by 1.)
531828.Flavor Text: “Not much of a roadblock, but I suppose I’ll do.”

532521.Description: [You'll Never Even Miss It] When you play this character, chosen opponent reveals their hand and discards a song card of your choice.

532522.Description: Rush (This character can challenge the turn they're played.)
532522.Flavor Text:
"Who thought giving him power armor was a good idea?!"
—Nani

532523.Description:
(A character with cost 3 or more can [Exert] to sing this song for free.)
Remove up to 3 damage from chosen character. Draw a card.
532523.Flavor Text:
Let your power shine
Make the clock reverse...

532639.Description: [Incredible Energy] [Exert], 1 Ink — Name a card, then reveal the top card of your deck. If it's the named card, put that card into your hand. Otherwise, put it on top of your deck.
532639.Flavor Text: Minnie approached it cautiously. Whoever had placed it here might have prepared traps.

532640.Description: Chosen character gets -2 Strength this turn. Draw a card.

532660.Description:
[This Is It!] When you play this character, you may play a location with cost 4 or less for free.
[Take The Helm] Whenever you play a location, this character may move there for free.
532660.Flavor Text:
"You're gonna rattle the stars, you are."
—John Silver

532859.Description: [Isolated] Characters gain Resist +1 while here. (Damage dealt to them is reduced by 1.)
532859.Flavor Text: Nothing but boulders and sand—easy to miss.

532860.Description:
[I'm Going Home!] During your turn, this character gains Evasive. (They can challenge characters with Evasive.)
[I Didn't Get Rich By Being Stupid] During your turn, whenever this character banishes another character in a challenge, you may play an item for free.

532861.Description:
Shift 3 (You may pay 3 Ink to play this on top of one of your characters named Moana.)
[Welcome To My Boat] Whenever this character quests while at a location, ready all other characters here. They can't quest for the rest of this turn.

532862.Description: [Twilight Bark] Once per turn, you may pay 2 Ink to reveal the top card of your deck. If it's a character card, put it into your hand. Otherwise, put it on the bottom of your deck.
532862.Flavor Text: "We'll find our way. I know we will!"

532867.Description: [Where Did They All Come From?] You may have up to 99 copies of Dalmatian Puppy — Tail Wagger in your deck.
532867.Flavor Text: First they steal your heart. Then they steal your chair.

532868.Description: [Where Did They All Come From?] You may have up to 99 copies of Dalmatian Puppy — Tail Wagger in your deck.
532868.Flavor Text: First they steal your heart. Then they steal your chair.

532869.Flavor Text: First they steal your heart. Then they steal your chair.

532870.Flavor Text: First they steal your heart. Then they steal your chair.

532871.Description: [Where Did They All Come From?] You may have up to 99 copies of Dalmatian Puppy — Tail Wagger in your deck.
532871.Flavor Text: First they steal your heart. Then they steal your chair.

532924.Description: [Eerie Pair] Your characters named Jetsam get +3 Strength.
532924.Flavor Text: "Ursula needs lore to complete her plan...."

532928.Description:
Ward (Opponents can't choose this character except to challenge.)
[Eerie Pair] Your characters named Flotsam gain Ward.
532928.Flavor Text: "There must be powerful lore here, very powerful."

533439.Description:
Support (Whenever this character quests, you may add their Strength to another chosen character's Strength this turn.)
[Three Nephews] Whenever this character quests, if you have characters named Dewey and Louie in play, you may draw 3 cards.
533439.Flavor Text: "This looks like part of a larger crystal!"

533440.Description: Support (Whenever this character quests, you may add their Strength to another chosen character's Strength this turn.)
533440.Flavor Text: "I got it! I knew I could do it! Dewey for the win!"

533442.Description: Support (Whenever this character quests, you may add their Strength to another chosen character's Strength this turn.)

533884.Description: [Surrounded By Water] Characters gain Ward and Evasive while here. (Opponents can't choose them except to challenge. Only characters with Evasive can challenge them.)
533884.Flavor Text: A nation protected by fierce assassins and their even fiercer cats.

534089.Flavor Text: The mermaids told Peter they'd seen some items floating by several days earlier, but they were more concerned that one of their sisters had gone missing.

534090.Flavor Text:
"They say the ol' place is haunted, or bewitched, or some such fiddle-faddle."
—Colonel

534468.Description: [Seeking Knowledge] Whenever one of your characters quests, you may look at the top card of your deck. Put it on either the top or the bottom of your deck.
534468.Flavor Text:
“It can point you toward lost lore, but if you're not careful, it'll lead you off a cliff.”
—Venturo, an Illumineer

534474.Flavor Text:
“Welcome to Agrabah, city of mystery, of enchantment, and the finest merchandise this side of the river.”
—Merchant

534477.Description: [Reincarnation] Whenever a character is banished while here, you may put that card into your inkwell facedown and exerted.

534480.Description: Whenever one of your characters quests this turn, gain 1 lore.
534480.Flavor Text:
“Two, four, six, and three is nine, plus two is 11 ...”
—Roger

534601.Description:
(A character with cost 4 or more can [Exert] to sing this song for free.)
Deal 5 damage to chosen character or location.
534601.Flavor Text:
He hurled his thunderbolt—He zapped
Locked those suckers in a vault—They're trapped
And on his own stopped chaos in its tracks

535148.Description:
[Broom Closet] Your characters named Magic Broom may move here for free.
[Magical Power] Characters get +1 Lore while here.
535148.Flavor Text: Everything you need to make some magic.

535636.Description: [Triumphant Stance] During your turn, whenever this character banishes another character in a challenge, chosen opposing character can't challenge during their next turn.
535636.Flavor Text: With dangers multiplying all around, the pride needs its guardian.

535723.Description: Reckless (This character can't quest and must challenge each turn if able.)
535723.Flavor Text: “I survived the moon. How tough could the flooded Inklands be?”

536113.Flavor Text: If you want a bigger reward, you've got to take bigger risks.

536118.Description: [Mimicry] You may play any character with Shift on this character as if this character had any name.

536265.Description: [Surprise Maneuver] When this character is banished, you may banish chosen character.
536265.Flavor Text: The storm came out of nowhere, forcing Eric to turn back before he reached the mysterious structure at the edge of Lorcana.

536268.Description: [I Can Use That] Whenever one of your items is banished, you may put that card into your inkwell facedown and exerted.
536268.Flavor Text: She lives in a world of possibilities.

536269.Description:
Ward (Opponents can't choose this character except to challenge.)
[Spare Parts] Whenever this character quests, ready one of your items.

536271.Description: [Source of Magic] During your turn, whenever one of your characters is banished in a challenge, you may draw a card.
536271.Flavor Text:
“Summoned spirit from the dark
Show thyself before this arc.”
—Lena Sabrewing

536272.Description: [Number One] [Exert], 2 Ink — Choose a character of yours and gain lore equal to their Lore.
536272.Flavor Text: This one simple coin changed Scrooge's life forever.

536277.Description: [Life Giver] [Exert] — You pay 2 Ink less for the next character you play this turn.
536277.Flavor Text:
“It's what's keeping you—all of Atlantis-alive!”
–Milo Thatch

536279.Description:
[Well, Now You Know] When you play this character, chosen opposing character gains Reckless during their next turn. (They can't quest and must challenge if able.)
[Thanks For Volunteering] Whenever one of your other characters is banished, each opponent loses 1 lore.

536280.Flavor Text: “Believe me, studying gibberish really can take you places!”

536281.Description:
Shift 4 (You may pay 4 Ink to play this on top of one of your characters named Milo Thatch.)
[Take Them By Surprise] When this character is banished, return all opposing characters to their players' hands.
536281.Flavor Text: “You don't know what you're tampering with.”

536282.Description: [I'm Your Man!] While this character is at a location, he gets +2 Strength.
536282.Flavor Text: “My grandpa never told me about this place!”

536283.Flavor Text: “That was an order, not a suggestion. Let's go!”

536285.Description:
(A character with cost 5 or more can [Exert] to sing this song for free.)
Each player puts the top 3 cards of their deck into their inkwell facedown and exerted.
536285.Flavor Text: You got some power in your corner now

536564.Description: Bodyguard (This character may enter play exerted. An opposing character who challenges one of your characters must choose one with Bodyguard if able.)
536564.Flavor Text: She's seen strange things before, but nothing like this.

537173.Description: [Laboratory] If you have a character here, you pay 1 Ink less to play items.
537173.Flavor Text: Some of the most important tools in Lorcana are crafted here.

537218.Description: [I'll Check It Out] At the end of your turn, if this character is exerted, you may ready another chosen character of yours.
537218.Flavor Text: "You stay there. I'll look for scattered lore."

537383.Description: [Poor Souls] Whenever this character is challenged, each opponent chooses and discards a card.
537383.Flavor Text:
"Now, it's happened once or twice, someone couldn't pay the price..."
—Ursula

537384.Description: Move up to 2 characters of yours to the same location for free.

537394.Description: [Sealed Away] Your locations and characters at locations gain Resist +1. (Damage dealt to them is reduced by 1.)
537394.Flavor Text: Only Scrooge knows about this vault. And he's going to keep it that way.

537395.Description:
[Key to the Portal] [Exert] — You pay 1 Ink less for the next location you play this turn.
[Show the Way] You pay 1 Ink less to move your characters to a location.
537395.Flavor Text:
“Gentlemen, this must be kept under lock and key.”
–Captain Amelia

537406.Description: [Ancient Power] Banish this item — Remove up to 2 damage from each of your characters.
537406.Flavor Text: Rainwater lands as stone melts and dragons fly again.

537407.Description: Evasive (Only characters with Evasive can challenge this character.)
537407.Flavor Text:
“Your majesty certainly has a way with dumb animals.”
—Jafar

537408.Description: [Night Out] Characters can't be challenged while here.
537408.Flavor Text: In New Orleans, dreams can come true.

537607.Description: [All Ways Here Are My Ways] Whenever this character quests, your other Villain characters get +1 Lore this turn.
537607.Flavor Text: The more of the Inklands she claims, the more she wants.

537608.Flavor Text: “Some days, it's nice to let the river do the running.”

537610.Description: [Brute] While this character has damage, he gets +3 Strength.
537610.Flavor Text: Always keep him in front of you. And downwind, if possible.

537620.Description:
Resist +2 (Damage dealt to this character is reduced by 2.)
[Stone Skin] [Exert] — Chosen character gains Resist +2 this turn.

537623.Description: [Business Expertise] [Exert] — You pay 1 Ink less for the next item you play this turn.
537623.Flavor Text: Just the thing to top off another brilliant deal.

537626.Description: Move 1 damage counter from chosen character to chosen opposing character.
537626.Flavor Text:
“From magic ink I call this gift
Fly my minion, thy wings be swift!”
—Maleficent

537628.Description: [Good Dog] [Exert] — You pay 1 Ink less for the next character you play this turn.
537628.Flavor Text: He just can't wait for new friends to arrive!

537631.Description:
Shift 5 (You may pay 5 Ink to play this on top of one of your characters named Pluto.)
Bodyguard (This character may enter play exerted. An opposing character who challenges one of your characters must choose one with Bodyguard if able.)
[Guard Dog] At the start of your turn, remove up to 3 damage from this character.

537633.Description:
(A character with cost 3 or more can [Exert] to sing this song for free.)
Look at the top 5 cards of your deck. Put any number of them on the top or the bottom of your deck in any order. Gain 1 lore.

537636.Description: Deal 2 damage to chosen character or location.

537753.Description: Bodyguard (This character may enter play exerted. An opposing character who challenges one of your characters must choose one with Bodyguard if able.)
537753.Flavor Text: “Heading out to the Inklands? Come on back if you need patching up.”

537755.Description: Banish one of your characters with Reckless to banish chosen character with less Strength than that character.

537757.Description: [I Got To Be Going] [Exert] — If you've played 2 or more actions this turn, draw a card.
537757.Flavor Text: Discovered in the lost Sea Duck, it looked good as new.

537759.Description:
[Get Those Scurvy Brats!] During your turn, whenever one of your characters banishes another character in a challenge, you may pay 1 Ink to draw a card.
[Let's Have At It!] Your characters named Captain Hook gain Challenger +1. (They get +1 Strength while challenging.)

537761.Description: [Nothing Personal] When this character is challenged and banished, banish the challenging character.
537761.Flavor Text: “You said we were in this together!”

537764.Description:
Shift 3 (You may pay 3 Ink to play this on top of one of your characters named Helga Sinclair.)
[This Changes Everything] Whenever this character quests, you may deal 3 damage to chosen damaged character.

537826.Flavor Text:
It rages through the forest,
Wings spreod wide with flame
Spring sings its ancient chorus
And green renews its claim

537827.Description:
[Forest's Gift] [Exert] — Deal 1 damage to chosen damaged character or location.
[A Bit Of A Lark] Whenever a character of yours named Robin Hood quests, you may ready this item.
537827.Flavor Text:
“The forest always provides just what you need.”
—Robin Hood

537886.Description:
Evasive (Only characters with Evasive can challenge this character.)
[Inspiring Voice] Whenever you play a song, chosen character of yours gains Evasive until the start of your next turn.
537886.Flavor Text: Shipwrecks are great places to find lore—and hide from sharks!

537888.Description: Chosen character gains Support this turn. (Whenever they quest, you may add their Strength to another chosen character's Strength this turn.)
537888.Flavor Text:
"Snoops! I know you can look harder! Find me that lore!"
—Madame Medusa

537932.Description: Evasive (Only characters with Evasive can challenge this character.)
537932.Flavor Text: Prince John isn't the only one collecting "taxes"!

537933.Description: Ward (Opponents can't choose this character except to challenge.)
537933.Flavor Text: Even the bravest outlaw knows when to lie low.

537937.Flavor Text: "You call this an ambush? Tsk, tsk. It's barely a bushwhack."

537942.Description: [Taxes Should Hurt] Whenever you discard a card, you may deal 1 damage to chosen opposing character.
537942.Flavor Text: The thirteenth rule of Villainy: Take everything you can, but do it with a smile.

537943.Description:
Shift 4 (You may pay 4 Ink to play this on top of one of your characters named Little John.)
[Okay, Big Shot] While this character is exerted, your characters with Bodyguard gain Resist +1 and get +1 Lore. (Damage dealt to them is reduced by 1.)

537944.Description:
Shift 3 (You may pay 3 Ink to play this on top of one of your characters named Robin Hood.)
[Skilled Combatant] During your turn, whenever this character banishes another character in a challenge, gain 2 lore.
[The Good of Others] When this character is banished in a challenge, you may draw a card.

537945.Description: [The Bear] Whenever this character moves to a location, he gets +3 Strength this turn.
537945.Flavor Text: With Peter holding off Hook, Cubby did what he does best: break stuff.

537946.Flavor Text: Point him in the right direction, and he'll do the rest.

537948.Description:
[The Fox] If you have a character named Peter Pan in play, you play 1 Ink less to play this character.
Evasive (Only characters with Evasive can challenge this character.)

537951.Description:
Rush (This character can challenge the turn they're played.)
[Over Here, Tink] While you have a character named Tinker Bell in play, this character gets +2 Strength.
537951.Flavor Text: With Peter, plans often meant diving headlong into danger.

537953.Description:
Shift 3 (You may pay 3 Ink to play this on top of one of your characters named Kida.)
[Perhaps We Can Save Our Future] When you play this character, all characters get -3 Strength until the start of your next turn.

538197.Description: [I Am Your Master Now] When you play this character, look at the top 2 cards of your deck. Put one on the top of your deck and the other on the bottom.
538197.Flavor Text: "I will rule as far as the eye can see."

538216.Description: [Always There] When this character is banished, you may shuffle this card into your deck.
538216.Flavor Text: Always ready to lend a hand...er, snout.

538224.Description:
(A character with cost 2 or more can [Exert] to sing this song for free.)
Chosen opponent reveals their hand and discards a non-character card of your choice.
538224.Flavor Text: Forget about your worries and your strife....

538225.Description:
[Nemesis] During your turn, whenever this character banishes another character in a challenge, ready this character. He can't quest for the rest of this turn.
[Man-to-Man] Characters named Peter Pan lose Evasive and can't gain Evasive.

538227.Description:
Shift 4 (You may pay 4 Ink to play this on top of one of your characters named Peter Pan.)
Evasive (Only characters with Evasive can challenge this character.)
[You're Next!] Whenever he challenges a Pirate character, this character takes no damage from the challenge.

538229.Description: [Rebuild] [Exert] — Remove up to 2 damage from chosen location.
538229.Flavor Text: The right tool makes all the difference.

538230.Description: Exert chosen opposing character. Then chosen character of yours gains Challenger +2 this turn. (They get +2 Strength while challenging.)

538237.Description: [They'll Never See It Coming!] During your turn, this character gains Evasive. (They can challenge characters with Evasive.)
538237.Flavor Text: “Nobody tells Flintheart Glomgold what to do!”

538238.Description: Rush (This character can challenge the turn they're played.)
538238.Flavor Text: Born from the shadows. Saved by friendship.

538243.Flavor Text: “Hold up, cuz. Why not sit back and enjoy some sweet beats?”

538254.Description:
Shift 5 (You may pay 5 Ink to play this on top of one of your characters named Magica De Spell.)
[All Mine] Whenever this character quests, gain lore equal to the cost of one of your items in play.
538254.Flavor Text: “I can feel my powers growing the closer I get to Scrooge's precious dime!”

538255.Description: [Telekinesis] [Exert] — Return chosen item with cost equal to or less than this character's Strength to its player's hand.
538255.Flavor Text: “Do you know what I call this? A good start!”

538257.Flavor Text: “Feed my power, Dark Eclipse. Free my form from the abyss. Dormant magic now unchain, the Shadow Queen be whole again!”

538280.Description:
[Look Alive, You Swabs] Characters gain Rush while here. (They can challenge the turn they're played.)
[All Hands On Deck!] Your pirate characters may move here for free.

538292.Description: [Cybernetic Armor] Banish this item – Chosen character gains Resist +2 until the start of your next turn. (Damage dealt to them is reduced by 2.)
538292.Flavor Text: It stands in the Hall of Lorcana, waiting for someone to speak the secret words.

538296.Description:
(A character with cost 2 or more can [Exert] to sing this song for free.)
Draw 2 cards, then choose and discard a card.
538296.Flavor Text:
Please bring honor to us
Please bring honor to us all

538301.Description: [You're Too Late] Whenever this character quests, chosen opposing character can't ready at the start of their next turn.
538301.Flavor Text: The secret contract has already been written.

538305.Description: Remove up to 3 damage from one of your locations or characters.
538305.Flavor Text: “I'm thinkin' about opening a shop here. What do you think?”

538310.Description: Remove up to 3 damage from chosen location.

538328.Flavor Text: “Look at our home! There is no better place to be.”

538333.Description:
[It's Maui Time!] If you have a character named Maui in play, you may use this item's Shapeshift ability for free.
[Shapeshift] [Exert], 2 Ink — Choose one:
• Chosen character gains Evasive until the start of your next turn. (Only characters with Evasive can challenge them.)
• Chosen character gets +3 Strength this turn.

538336.Description: Bodyguard (This character may enter play exerted. An opposing character who challenges one of your characters must choose one with Bodyguard if able.)

538342.Description: [Mindless Wandering] Once per turn, when this character moves to a location, each opponent loses 1 lore.

538345.Flavor Text: He'll join the hunt for lore after he's had a quick snack.

538347.Description:
Evasive (Only characters with Evasive can challenge this character.)
[Disassemble] [Exert] — Banish chosen item.
538347.Flavor Text: “I can take anything apart in under five minutes!”

538351.Flavor Text: “Finding lore is a lot easier when you have a grappling hook!”

538352.Description: Evasive (Only characters with Evasive can challenge this character.)
538352.Flavor Text: No fire or storm will keep her from her goal.

538353.Description: Support (Whenever this character quests, you may add their Strength to another chosen character's Strength this turn.)

538354.Description:
[Good As New] [Exert] — Reveal the top 3 cards of your deck. You may put each character card with cost 2 or less into your hand. Put the rest on the bottom of your deck in any order.
[Puppy Love] Whenever this character quests, if you have 4 or more other characters in play, your other characters get +1 Lore this turn.

538355.Description: Evasive (Only characters with Evasive can challenge this character.)
538355.Flavor Text: “You didn't expect to find me here, did you? Well neither did I.”

538357.Description: [Skysurfing] When you play this character, you may return chosen opposing character with 2 Strength or less to their player's hand.
538357.Flavor Text: “It's been fun, guys, but I got to be going. Yahoooo!”

538361.Description: [There Was Only Ocean] When you play this character, look at the top 2 cards of your deck. You may add one into your hand. Put the rest on the bottom of your deck in any order.
538361.Flavor Text: Listen with your whole heart, and the ancestors will guide you.

538365.Description: [Plunder] When you play this character, each opponent loses 1 lore.
538365.Flavor Text: There's a bunch more where he came from.

538368.Description: [Highborn Lady] When you play this character, chosen character gets -2 Strength this turn.

538370.Description: [Make A New Friend] When you play this character, look at the top 4 cards of your deck. You may reveal a character card and put it into your hand. Place the rest on the bottom of your deck in any order.

538374.Description: [Treasure Finder] Whenever this character quests, you pay 1 Ink less for the next item you play this turn.
538374.Flavor Text: A strange new world is the perfect place to make a strange new fortune!

538380.Flavor Text: With Tink's upgrades in place, Wendy took them to the skies to find the missing mermaid.

538458.Description:
[We Are All Connected] Characters get +2 Willpower while here.
[Lion Home] If you have a Prince or King character here, you pay 1 Ink less to play characters.

538680.Description: [Using the Mirror] At the start of your turn, for each character you have here, you may draw a card.
538680.Flavor Text: Those who visit the mirror can choose their question—but not the answer.

538681.Description: [City Walls] Whenever a character is challenged and banished while here, banish the challenging character.
538681.Flavor Text: "Sure it's a little small, but also it DOESN'T HAVE A POOL!" —Kuzco

538682.Description:
[This is Our Ship] Characters gain Evasive while here. (Only characters with Evasive can challenge them.)
[Heave Together Now] If you have a character here, you pay 2 Ink less to move a character of yours here.

538683.Description: [Show Me the Way] Whenever a character quests while here, you may draw a card, then choose and discard a card.
538683.Flavor Text: A place to find what you need, not just what you want.

538722.Description: [Come Along, Children] When you play this character and whenever she quests, you may play a character with cost 2 or less from your discard for free.

538723.Description:
(A character with cost 1 or more can [Exert] to sing this song for free.)
Chosen character of yours gets +2 Strength this turn. They may move to a location for free.
538723.Flavor Text:
I would go most anywhere
To feel like I belong

538724.Description: [Three Wishes] Whenever this character quests, you may shuffle this card into your deck to draw 3 cards.
538724.Flavor Text: "Right here, direct from the lamp, right here for your very much wish fulfillment.”

538725.Description:
Shift 5 (You may pay 5 Ink to play this on top of one of your characters named Jafar.)
Evasive (Only characters with Evasive can challenge this character.)
[Power beyond Measure] During your turn, while this character is exerted, whenever you draw a card, gain 1 lore.

538726.Description:
This card was originally printed with the incorrect Classification of Storyborn.
[What a Deal] Whenever this character sings a song, you may play that song again from your discard for free, then put it on the bottom of your deck.
538726.Flavor Text: "I don't want much—just the most powerful lore!"

538727.Description:
Shift 5 (You may pay 5 Ink to play this on top of one of your characters named Gramma Tala.)
[Do You Know Who You Are?] Whenever a card is put into your inkwell, gain 1 lore.
538727.Flavor Text: She will always be with you, no matter how far your journey takes you.

538728.Description: [This Going to be Good] Whenever you play a song, you may put the top card of your deck into your inkwell facedown and exerted.
538728.Flavor Text: “You dig a little deeper, you’ll find everything you need.”

538729.Description: [Curiouser and Curiouser] [Exert] — Exert chosen opposing character and all other opposing characters with the same name.
538729.Flavor Text: With the right tea leaves and a little magic, she creates the perfect cup for any party guest.

539060.Description:
Bodyguard (This character may enter play exerted. An opposing character who challenges one of your characters must choose one with Bodyguard if able.)
[Let's Make Like a Tree] When this character is banished, gain 2 lore.

539061.Description:
[The Power of Evil] For each character card in your discard, you pay 1 Ink less to play this character.
[Summon the Spirits] When you play this character, shuffle all character cards from your discard into your deck.
